notes.title: Dive into the "Space Odyssey" with the New full-body Avatars！🚀🌌👾👗🎉
notes.content:
[b]Update Highlights[/b]
1. Our fashion mall now boasts six new full-body avatars, available for purchase with gold and diamonds.
2. Dive into the brand-new sub-game, "Space Odyssey"! This dual-player online game is a thrilling VR shooting survival adventure, infused with Roguelite random elements.
3. We've introduced an "Invite a Friend" feature in the settings. Use "My Invitation Code" to invite players. Once they enter the code, you'll instantly become friends and both receive special rewards.
4. The sub-game "Fruit Adventure" now has 5 additional levels to conquer.
5. Our task system now offers "Gacha Machine Draws" as rewards, including one daily draw and five weekly draws.

[list]
[*] Introducing Space Odyssey
[/list]
Adventurers, set foot on a mysterious planet and team up with your trusty robot sidekick to level up and hold your ground against waves of monsters! Dive into this dual-player game, gear up with a variety of weapons like crossbows, pistols, assault rifles, grenade launchers, and shotguns. Pair them with elemental robots—wood, fire, earth, metal, and water—for dynamic combat combinations. With Roguelike elements, defeat monsters to earn diamonds. After each wave, visit the shop to choose your unique upgrade path. Whether you're enhancing your summons or boosting your weapon's critical hits, countless choices await. Every game promises a fresh experience!

[list]
[*] Full-Body Avatar Details
[/list]
The much-anticipated full-body avatars are here! Dive into a plethora of customization options and express yourself. Mix and match eyes, face shapes, hairstyles, and more to craft your unique style and be the star of any virtual party. Importantly, the full-body avatar is an option. If you're fond of the classic half-body avatar, you can stick with it and retain your original look.

[list]
[*] About the "Invite a Friend" System
[/list]
Players can find their unique invitation code in the settings. Share it with the friend you wish to invite. Once they input the code, both of you will be rewarded and instantly become friends. Let's grow our community together!
